projects.name: RouteLedger
projects.description: Delivery-tracking backend for a small courier startup. Drivers post location pings, dispatchers query live routes, and a nightly job summarises late deliveries per region.
highlights: Designed REST endpoints for pings, routes and delivery summaries
Deduplicated repeated driver pings with a hash map keyed by driver and minute
Cut a slow summary query by pre-aggregating per-region counts

projects.name: ClubDesk
projects.description: Event-registration API for college clubs. Members sign up for events, organisers export attendance, and seat limits are enforced per event.
highlights: Implemented waitlist promotion when a registered member cancels
Merged two sorted attendance exports with a two-pointer pass
